name: Liquid Crystal
description: Twisted-nematic cell between crossed polarizers. The analyzer now obeys Malus's law and rotates toward a held pointer, producing the dark extinction brushes real liquid-crystal microscopy shows — previously no analyzer existed at all, so the effect's most recognisable feature could not appear. Transmitted light relaxes through dataTextureC with an asymmetric Frederiks time constant. Scene depth is preserved (it was previously overwritten with polarization alpha).

updatedParams.name: Cell Thickness

updatedParams.name: Twist Angle
updatedParams.description: Total director twist across the cell, 0-2pi — maps to zoom_params.y.

updatedParams.name: Birefringence
updatedParams.description: Index difference (delta n), 0.1-0.3 — maps to zoom_params.z.

updatedParams.name: Voltage
